description: Code Engine config maps: non-secret key/value settings for apps and jobs. Identify one with project_id and config_map_name. Call get_schema with name ce_config_map for every action's fields.

action.description: list: List config maps. | get: Get one config map with its data. Needs config_map_name. | create: Create a config map from a data object. Needs config_map_name, data. | update: Replace the data of a config map; keys not in data are removed. Needs config_map_name, data. | delete: Delete a config map. Needs config_map_name.

config_map_name.description: Config map name, from ce_config_map action list.

project_id.description: Project id or name, from ce_project action list.

name: ce_config_map
